text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —How pathetic of me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In striving to be a strong "Emperor," in the end...
I failed to stand at the pinnacle.
choice_data_list: But you're still your proud self.
But you're still your proud self, you know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As long as we hold fast to our pride,
people may still place their hopes in us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. In this race swirling with everyone's
expectations, I want to deliver results next time."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Let us move forward, guided by that trust.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll stage a comeback and keep challenging without giving up.

And so,
after setting our sights on the Arima Kinen for our next race...
Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Brian.
How unusual for you to come watch me."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I was curious to see who the strongest Umamusume truly was.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And the result was... unfortunate.
How does it feel to be knocked off your throne?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph, just putting up a brave front, are we?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think the headline "The Return of the Emperor"
has quite a charming ring to it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hah... impressive as always.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love to cross swords with you one day.
Taking a bite out of you sounds like fun."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you on anytime.
If it's just a little love bite, I don't mind pampering you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it,
is Air Groove not here today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps it was conceit to think you'd come watch.
Or... did something go wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Your prying couldn't be any more obvious.
That's not like you at all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I haven't done anything to—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you worried whether I'm keeping up
unless you look back?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway,
I saw your run with my own eyes."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well, get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I owe you one.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer-kun.
About what Brian just said—"
(Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, I'm from the newspaper company.
Do you have a moment to spare?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not at all.
Please wait a moment while I prepare it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, let's talk later.
Right now, it's interview time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What will the defeated 'Emperor' target next?
I need the press corps to hype it up properly.

"...However, I was kept busy with interviews after that,
and never got the chance to speak with Symboli Rudolf."
